questions.question: What rhetorical question shows the prophet must speak in Amos 3?
options: The harvest is past; who will not weep? The famine has come; who can but mourn?
The day is dark; who will not tremble? The end has come; who can but despair?
The trumpet has loudly sounded; who will not flee? The army has come; who can but fight?
The lion has roared; who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken; who can but prophesy?
questions.answer: The lion has roared; who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken; who can but prophesy?

questions.question: What does Amos 3 say God does before acting?
options: Hides his plans from all the nations
Sends his word by the kings of the earth
Speaks only through the priests at the high altar
Reveals his secret to his servants the prophets
questions.answer: Reveals his secret to his servants the prophets

questions.question: Amos 3 says, 'You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you.'
The _____ has roared; who will not fear?
The Lord GOD does nothing without revealing his secret to his servants the _____.
